name: com.veerdonk.projectile-system
description: Kinematic projectile simulation for Unity 6: spawn, tick, pool, hits, and six-stage Recipe modifiers (pierce, bounce, multiply, authored multiply grids, multicast, homing, combat scales, area, ground fields, ballistic aim, Delivery Straight / Arc / Hitscan / Beam).

samples.description: Import this sample, open Scenes/Yard.unity, and enter Play Mode. The turret calls Spawn and Tick; dummy HP listens to Hit.
